title: 使用天平
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/11_Using a Balance.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/11_Using a Balance/src.py

points.K8: 称物体：读稳定值，三次平均
points.K11: 放容器去皮，称量纸先折痕
points.K14: 用完清洁，比来时更整洁
points.K21: 冷热物体回到室温再称
points.K28: 挥发液体用带盖称量瓶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带玻璃罩的分析天平旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an analytical balance with a glass draft shield and a blank display, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学分析天平怎么用、怎么爱护。

shots.scene: 称量、环境、维护三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a balance with a weigh boat, a door with an air current arrow, and a soft brush. No people.
shots.narration: 称量方法、环境影响、故障判断都会讲。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着试剂瓶直接往秤盘上的称量纸倒粉末，侧门大开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tips a reagent bottle straight onto a weigh paper on the balance pan with the side door wide open.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶时间，拿瓶子直接往秤上倒。

shots.scene: 显示屏数字乱跳，秤盘上撒了粉末
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank balance display with flickering bars and some powder spilled on the pan. No people.
shots.narration: 读数乱跳，秤盘上还撒了药。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰刮勺和软毛刷，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a spatula and a soft brush, shaking her head gently.
shots.narration: 小研说：天平很娇气，规矩得一条条守。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍天平的玻璃罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the glass draft shield of the balance.
shots.narration: 天平是化学实验室用得最多的仪器。

shots.scene: 技术、爱护、维护三个图标连成一线指向勾号
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a hand, a heart and a wrench, connected by arrows to a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 方法对、爱护好，才能称得准、用得久。

shots.scene: 同一个砝码在地球和月球上，质量相同
shots.prompt_en: The same weight block shown on Earth and on the Moon with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 质量是物质的多少，在哪儿都一样。

shots.scene: 弹簧秤在地球和月球上伸长不同
shots.prompt_en: A spring scale stretching far on Earth and only a little on the Moon. No people.
shots.narration: 重量是重力，换个地方就变。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在地球上耸肩微笑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a small globe and shrugs with a smile.
shots.narration: 在地球上两者成正比，平时可混用。

shots.scene: 四台天平由简到精排开
shots.prompt_en: Four balances in a row from simple to precise: a triple beam balance, a top-loading balance, an analytical balance with a draft shield, and a small micro balance. No people.
shots.narration: 常见四类：三梁、顶载、分析、微量天平。

shots.scene: 四台天平下方显示各自精度
shots.prompt_en: The same four balances, each with a small glowing tag under it. No people.
shots.narration: 精度依次是十毫克、一毫克。

shots.scene: 后两台天平高亮
shots.prompt_en: The analytical and micro balances light up. No people.
shots.narration: 零点一毫克，和千分之一毫克。

shots.scene: 精度越高，风和温度图标越多，价签越大
shots.prompt_en: A rising staircase of balances with more wind and thermometer icons and a bigger price tag at each step. No people.
shots.narration: 越精密，越怕环境干扰，也越贵。

shots.scene: 欣欣比出“刚刚好”的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot makes a just-right gesture with paw and fingers.
shots.narration: 所以选天平，精度够用就好。

shots.scene: 顶载天平上放着一大烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A top-loading balance with a large beaker on it. No people.
shots.narration: 顶载天平用来粗称，或称过量的试剂。

shots.scene: 分析天平上放着小样品瓶
shots.prompt_en: An analytical balance with a small vial inside the closed draft shield. No people.
shots.narration: 要精确，就用分析天平。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着分析天平
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the analytical balance.
shots.narration: 下面讲分析天平，顶载天平同样适用。

shots.scene: 手指按下天平开机键，钟表图标
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger presses the power key of the balance; a clock icon appears beside it.
shots.narration: 先开机，预热三十分钟。

shots.scene: 小研打开侧门察看秤盘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the side door and looks at the balance pan.
shots.narration: 看看天平干不干净。

shots.scene: 软毛刷轻扫秤盘
shots.prompt_en: A soft brush gently sweeps dust off the balance pan.
shots.narration: 有灰就用软毛刷扫干净。

shots.scene: 侧门关上，手指按去皮键
shots.prompt_en: The side doors slide shut and a gloved finger presses the tare bar.
shots.narration: 关好侧门，按去皮键。

shots.scene: 显示屏显示零
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the balance display showing a single zero with no other symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 稳定时显示零，没有别的提示符。

shots.section_title: 称物体：读稳定值，三次平均
shots.scene: 小瓶放在秤盘正中，关门
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand places a small glass vial in the center of the pan and closes the door.
shots.narration: 物体放在秤盘中央，关门。
overlay: 称物体：读稳定值，三次平均

shots.section_title: 称物体：读稳定值，三次平均
shots.scene: 显示屏数字由跳动到停止
shots.prompt_en: The display bars flicker and then settle on a steady value. No people.
shots.narration: 数字不跳了，再记录。

shots.section_title: 称物体：读稳定值，三次平均
shots.scene: 三次读数相加求平均的图示
shots.prompt_en: Three blank number cards joined by plus signs and an average bar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 取下重称两次，三次取平均。

shots.scene: 刮勺上的粉末直接撒向秤盘的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of powder from a spatula falling directly onto the bare balance pan, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 称药品，绝不能让药品碰到秤盘。

shots.scene: 空样品瓶放在秤盘上
shots.prompt_en: A clean empty glass vial sits on the balance pan. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要用合适的容器。

shots.scene: 直接称进反应瓶，省去转移
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask on a cork ring sits on the pan, with a skipped arrow icon showing no transfer step. No people.
shots.narration: 最好直接称进反应容器，少一步损失。

shots.scene: 大小称量舟和大小称量纸
shots.prompt_en: A large and a small weigh boat next to a large and a small square of weigh paper. No people.
shots.narration: 不能直接称，就选最小的称量舟或纸。

shots.scene: 大容器上一点点药品，天平图标显示难分辨
shots.prompt_en: A heavy container with a tiny pinch of powder, beside a balance icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 容器越重，小小的药量越难称准。

shots.scene: 大称量舟壁上粘着粉末
shots.prompt_en: A large weigh boat with powder stuck to its wide walls compared to a small clean boat. No people.
shots.narration: 面积越大，粘住带不走的越多。

shots.section_title: 放容器去皮，称量纸先折痕
shots.scene: 称量纸放上秤盘，关门去皮
shots.prompt_en: A weigh paper is placed on the pan, the door closed and the tare bar pressed. No people.
shots.narration: 容器放上去，关门，去皮。
overlay: 放容器去皮，称量纸先折痕

shots.section_title: 放容器去皮，称量纸先折痕
shots.scene: 手沿对角线折称量纸
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands crease a square weigh paper along its diagonal.
shots.narration: 称量纸先沿对角线折一道，好倒。

shots.scene: 称量纸取出天平，刮勺加药
shots.prompt_en: The weigh paper is taken out of the balance and a spatula adds powder onto it outside the shield.
shots.narration: 取出容器，在外面用刮勺加药。

shots.scene: 放回关门读数
shots.prompt_en: The loaded paper goes back on the pan and the door is closed for a reading. No people.
shots.narration: 放回去关门读数。

shots.scene: 多余药品倒进废物杯，倒回原瓶的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Excess powder is tapped into a small waste beaker with a blank label; an icon of pouring it back into the reagent bottle is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 多了放进废物容器，绝不倒回原瓶。

shots.scene: 每次加药都把容器取出来
shots.prompt_en: A loop of arrows shows the paper coming out, getting a little more powder, and going back in. No people.
shots.narration: 少了再加，每次都先取下来。

shots.scene: 药品从称量纸倒进圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Powder slides off the creased paper into a round-bottom flask.
shots.narration: 药品倒进反应瓶。

shots.scene: 空称量纸再上天平
shots.prompt_en: The empty weigh paper is weighed again; a minus sign icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 再称一下空纸，差值才是实际用量。

shots.section_title: 用完清洁，比来时更整洁
shots.scene: 软毛刷清扫秤盘，纸巾擦干台面
shots.prompt_en: A soft brush sweeps the pan and a paper towel wipes the bench around the balance.
shots.narration: 用完扫净固体，擦干液体。
overlay: 用完清洁，比来时更整洁

shots.section_title: 用完清洁，比来时更整洁
shots.scene: 关上侧门，带走自己的东西
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the doors and carries away her bottles and spatula.
shots.narration: 关好门防灰，带走自己的东西。

shots.section_title: 用完清洁，比来时更整洁
shots.scene: 干净的天平台，闪光
shots.prompt_en: A spotless balance table with a little sparkle. No people.
shots.narration: 让天平比你来时更整洁。

shots.scene: 天平秤一边是手，一边是房子图标
shots.prompt_en: A seesaw icon balancing a gloved hand on one side and a room icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 称得准不准，看技术，也看环境。

shots.scene: 侧门开着，风的箭头吹动秤盘
shots.prompt_en: An open side door with wind arrows making the pan wobble. No people.
shots.narration: 侧门要一直关着，风会吹动秤盘。

shots.scene: 手撑在天平台上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand leaning on the balance table, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别倚靠天平台，也别把手搭上去。

shots.scene: 裸手指纹印在玻璃瓶上，戴手套的手对比
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a bare fingerprint smudge on a glass vial with an up arrow, and a gloved hand holding a clean vial. No people.
shots.narration: 戴手套，手上油脂会让质量偏高。

shots.scene: 纸巾擦干称量容器外壁
shots.prompt_en: A paper towel wipes the outside of a small vial dry.
shots.narration: 容器外壁要完全擦干。

shots.scene: 物体放在秤盘中心的示意
shots.prompt_en: Top view of the pan with a vial placed exactly at the center marker. No people.
shots.narration: 放在秤盘正中间。

shots.scene: 潮湿的药品放进干燥器
shots.prompt_en: A dish of damp powder is placed into a glass desiccator. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿的药品先干燥，不然读数偏高。

shots.scene: 对着样品瓶哈气的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of breath clouds blowing onto a vial, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别对着物体哈气，水汽会让它变重。

shots.scene: 从干燥器取出的瓶子，空气中水滴图标飘向它
shots.prompt_en: A vial just taken out of a desiccator with tiny water droplet icons drifting toward it. No people.
shots.narration: 超干的东西，放着放着就吸湿变重。

shots.scene: 每次取出都看同一时刻的钟表
shots.prompt_en: A row of clock icons all showing the same interval after a desiccator lid opens. No people.
shots.narration: 所以每次都隔相同时间再称。

shots.section_title: 冷热物体回到室温再称
shots.scene: 热的坩埚放进干燥器冷却
shots.prompt_en: A hot crucible with heat lines is placed into a desiccator to cool. No people.
shots.narration: 热的东西放进干燥器冷却，防吸湿。
overlay: 冷热物体回到室温再称

shots.section_title: 冷热物体回到室温再称
shots.scene: 秤盘上方的对流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A hot vial on the pan with swirling air arrows rising above it. No people.
shots.narration: 冷热物体会搅起气流，读数不稳。

shots.section_title: 冷热物体回到室温再称
shots.scene: 温度计回到室温刻度
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon settling at the room temperature mark beside a vial. No people.
shots.narration: 一定等它回到室温再称。

shots.scene: 直接放秤盘、在秤上加药两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: powder lying on the bare pan, and a spatula adding powder to a boat while it sits on the pan. No people.
shots.narration: 不直接放秤盘，不在秤上加药。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶直接倒的图标被打叉，刮勺打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of tipping a reagent bottle into a weigh boat crossed out, beside a spatula with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不拿瓶子直接倒，用刮勺。

shots.scene: 秤盘上压着大烧杯的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oversized heavy container crushing the pan, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看清最大称量，不超载。

shots.scene: 取下物品后显示屏回到零
shots.prompt_en: After the vial is removed, the display returns to a single zero. No people.
shots.narration: 取下物品，读数应该回到零。

shots.scene: 显示屏停在一个小数值，警示图标
shots.prompt_en: The display stays on a small leftover value with a warning icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 剩零点三毫克以上，零点偏了，要重称。

shots.scene: 空秤盘读数不停变化
shots.prompt_en: The display keeps creeping up and down with nothing on the pan. No people.
shots.narration: 读数总不稳定，空载也在变，叫漂移。

shots.scene: 老李检查天平
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the analytical balance with a small notebook.
shots.narration: 波动比平时明显变大，就是出故障了。

shots.scene: 温度计图标，房间温度曲线平稳
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a flat steady temperature line across a room. No people.
shots.narration: 室温和天平内部温度要恒定。

shots.scene: 塑料容器带电火花图标，湿度计
shots.prompt_en: A plastic container with small static spark icons, next to a humidity gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 少用塑料容器，湿度不要太低，防静电。

shots.scene: 排查清单：门、湿样、干样
shots.prompt_en: A checklist board with icons: an open door, a damp sample with vapor, a dry sample pulling droplets in. No people.
shots.narration: 漂移大：门没关？样品在蒸发或吸湿？

shots.scene: 清单继续：冷热样品、静电
shots.prompt_en: The checklist continues with icons of a hot sample with swirling air and a sample with static sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 样品不是室温？还是带了静电？

shots.scene: 第一个稳定两秒的数字被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A timeline of display readings where the first value held for two seconds is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 漂移时，取最先出现并稳住两秒的数。

shots.scene: 移液管、自动移液器、注射器、滴定管
shots.prompt_en: A glass pipette with a bulb, an automatic pipette, a syringe and a burette laid side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 称液体，通常先量体积。

shots.scene: 体积乘以密度等于质量的图示
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a measuring cylinder times a density symbol equals a weight block. No people.
shots.narration: 再用密度换算成质量，又快又准。

shots.scene: 粘稠的液体缓慢流下，放在天平上
shots.prompt_en: A thick syrupy liquid slowly dripping into a vial on the balance. No people.
shots.narration: 粘稠液体量不准，就直接称。

shots.section_title: 挥发液体用带盖称量瓶
shots.scene: 带磨口盖的称量瓶
shots.prompt_en: A small glass weighing bottle with a ground glass lid on the pan. No people.
shots.narration: 易挥发的液体，用带盖称量瓶。
overlay: 挥发液体用带盖称量瓶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的天平前竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up in front of a clean balance with closed doors.
shots.narration: 天平不难用，靠的是好习惯。

shots.scene: 干净的天平和稳定的读数
shots.prompt_en: A tidy balance with a steady display value and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 保持干净，天平才一直靠得住。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现预热、去皮、平均三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a clock, a tare button and an average sign.
shots.narration: 预热、清扫、去皮，三次平均。

shots.scene: 刮勺、小称量舟、废物杯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spatula, a small weighing boat and a waste cup. No people.
shots.narration: 取下加药，多了不倒回，差减求用量。

shots.scene: 关门、手套、温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed balance door, a gloved hand and a thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 关门防风，干燥、室温、不哈气。

shots.scene: 零读数和漂移曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a zero reading and a wavy drift line. No people.
shots.narration: 回不到零、漂移变大，就要排查。

shots.scene: 带盖称量瓶和整洁天平图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a weighing bottle with a lid and a tidy balance. No people.
shots.narration: 挥发液体加盖称，天平用完要整洁。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的天平前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a clean analytical balance.
shots.narration: 称得准，用得好，下次见！
